name: Tvg_Audio_Info
brief: Describes the current state of a Lottie audio layer.
description: This structure is provided to the audio resolver callback and contains the information required to synchronize audio playback with the animation timeline. Applications are responsible for managing audio playback using their own audio engine.
Example: @code void on_audio(const Tvg_Audio_Info* info, void* data) { if (info->active) { // Start or seek playback of info->src. } else { // Stop playback of info->src. } } @endcode

members.name: src
members.brief: Audio source: a file path/URL or embedded raw bytes.

members.name: mimeType
members.brief: MIME type string; valid when `embedded`; may be `NULL`.

members.name: size
members.brief: Embedded data size in bytes; valid when `embedded`.

members.name: offset
members.brief: Position within the audio file in seconds; valid when `active`.

members.name: active
members.brief: `true` while the layer is within its playback range.

members.name: embedded
members.brief: `true` if `src` points to embedded audio data; `false` if it is a file path or URL.
